title: Constructor Studio Kit Constraints (constraints.json)
description: Kit-level constraints for artifact IDs. Artifact kinds (e.g. PRD, DESIGN, FEATURE) live under `artifacts`; in the legacy unwrapped layout they are root keys instead.

artifacts.description: Wrapped layout: map of artifact kind to its constraints.

validation.description: Kit-wide validation policy. Lifted out before the `artifacts` unwrap, so that it is never mistaken for an artifact kind named VALIDATION in the legacy layout.

severity.description: error gates the run, warning is reported without gating, off suppresses the rule (and is counted in the report's suppressed_count). An unrecognised value fails the load rather than resolving to no opinion.

severity_table.description: Map of rule code to severity.

severity.description: Rule code to severity. At the root a value may also be a table keyed by artifact kind; under an artifact kind only rule codes are accepted.

toc.description: Whether the TOC phase runs for this artifact kind (default true).

validation.description: Validation policy scoped to this artifact kind. Overrides the kit-wide table for the same rule code.

headings.description: Outline contract for markdown headings within this artifact kind.

identifiers.description: Map of id kind to its constraint entry.

headings.description: Allowed heading constraint ids where this ID kind may be defined.

task.description: Whether task checkbox is required (true), prohibited (false), or allowed (null/omitted).

priority.description: Whether priority marker is required (true), prohibited (false), or allowed (null/omitted).

severity.description: Severity for the rules this ID-kind entry owns, overriding the code's default.

locked.description: When true, a project may raise this entry's rules but may not lower them; the refusal is reported.

references.description: Map of artifact kinds to reference rules.

coverage.description: Whether reference is required (true), prohibited (false), or optional (null/omitted).

task.description: Whether task checkbox is required (true), prohibited (false), or allowed (null/omitted).

priority.description: Whether priority marker is required (true), prohibited (false), or allowed (null/omitted).

headings.description: Heading constraint ids that define required locations for references (when coverage=required). Otherwise, references are allowed anywhere unless coverage=prohibited.

multiple.description: Whether multiple occurrences are required (true), prohibited (false), or allowed (null/omitted).

numbered.description: Whether numbered headings are required (true), prohibited (false), or allowed (null/omitted).

prev.description: Heading constraint id expected before this one. Parsed and used in message text only; ordering is not enforced from it.

next.description: Heading constraint id expected after this one. Parsed and used in message text only; ordering is not enforced from it.

severity.description: Severity for the rules this heading entry owns, overriding the code's default. A required heading declared `warning` is reported when absent rather than failing the run.

locked.description: When true, a project may raise this entry's rules but may not lower them; the refusal is reported.
